This function cannot be used until \n
the game has been saved.\n

Pressing SELECT will \n
reset the system settings.\n

You can view data on all defeated \n
enemies.\n

You can view data on all furniture \n
picked up.\n

You can listen to BGM and \n
sound effects.\n
Change location of saved game data.\n
Select data you wish to copy.\n
Select saved data you wish to delete.\n
Select game data you wish to change.\n
It is locked with a magic spell. \n

You can listen to the BGM \n
used in the game. \n

You can listen to the sound \n
effects used in the game.\n

It is not possible to quick save\n
right now.\n
You can hear machines moving above.\n

Please purchase something from me. \n
You do have money, don't you?\n

If you show me something of value, \n
I may trade a bit of coin for it.\n

So, are you done with your business \n
with me?\n
